name: Vector 24-Hour World-Class Benchmark
claimPolicy: Do not claim broad competitive superiority. A superiority claim may only be made for a named capability after the corresponding live evidence gate passes.

winningDimensions.target: Connect people, skills, certifications, availability, shifts, production demand, labour cost, compliance, outcomes and learning in one operational model.
A customer can move from signed contract to configured isolated environment, integrations, validated data, training and handover without routine human implementation work.
Discover, connect, map and continuously verify enterprise systems through reusable adapters and safe middleware-compatible patterns.
AI explains what matters, why it matters, recommended action, expected impact and can execute bounded approved actions with audit evidence.
Every savings claim separates identified opportunity from realised/verified value and links to source evidence.
Role-specific, task-first screens with no unnecessary information, no persistent horizontal overflow and a clear answer to 'so what?' on every data surface.
Fast self-service for leave, entitlement, shifts, availability, clocking and status with context before committing actions.
Optimise staffing against demand, skills, constraints, cost and productivity; extend to agency and energy decisions when evidence is available.
Trace payroll-ready outputs back to time/workforce evidence and reconcile expected simulation results without silent error.
Security, tenant isolation, performance, observability, accessibility, resilience and rollback are automated release gates rather than optional review steps.

releaseRule: Any failed release-blocking dimension prevents a world-class claim for that dimension. Unknown evidence is not a pass.
